meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 用来回答代码库问题:Claude 会读取项目里的知识图谱文件(需先运行 /understand 生成),按你的问题在图谱中找相关节点和关联,并引用具体文件、函数和分层来作答;没有图谱时会提示先运行 /understand。
howto.when: 当你需要询问代码库相关问题、用知识图谱理解代码时;最直接的入口是使用 /understand-chat 命令提问。

say.text: 这个代码库里用户登录涉及哪些文件和函数?
say.note: Claude 会从图谱节点和边的关联中回答。

say.text: graph 节点 client 都依赖哪些模块?
say.note: 它会沿着 imports/calls 边找出上游依赖。
它读取 layers 并解释各层职责。

howto.what_en: On codebase questions, Claude reads the project's knowledge-graph file (run /understand first if missing), searches nodes/edges by your keywords, then answers with concrete files, functions, and layers; otherwise it prompts you to run /understand.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to ask about a codebase or understand code using the knowledge graph; the main entry is the /understand-chat command.

say_en.text: Which files and functions are involved in user login?
say_en.note: Answers from graph nodes and edges.

say_en.text: What modules does node client depend on?
What layers does the order module have?
